Compact reviewF5 · Option B

Validator heartbeat cleanup

TL;DR: This commit completes the chosen removal path: it deletes the validator’s unused heartbeat helper and stale environment setting, then makes the startup-order comment name the event that the code actually emits. The scoped cleanup is complete and is safe to accept.

Compared fix/val-doc-1 (67a87fc)…task/validator-fix-5 (66584b3). Shape: 3 files, 1 insertion, 52 deletions.

Contents What changed Verdict and residuals

What changed per file

validator-cli/src/utils/heartbeat.ts — deleted

The full 47-line HTTPS heartbeat helper is removed. It previously accepted a URL, sent a GET request with a 10-second timeout, and swallowed outer errors.

Why: this was dead validator code. At the base ref, the validator had no import or call to sendHeartbeat; its only heartbeat matches were this file, the sample environment entry, and one comment. Deletion therefore removes an abandoned capability rather than changing a live execution path.

validator-cli/.env.dist — remove HEARTBEAT_URL

The optional variable and its two explanatory comment lines are removed:

# Optional. Must be https if set - the heartbeat is only ever sent over https,
# so an http:// URL would silently never send.
HEARTBEAT_URL=

Why: advertising an unused setting implies monitoring behavior the validator does not provide. The environment validator also does not consume this variable, so the template now matches the implemented validator configuration.

validator-cli/src/watcher.ts — correct the startup comment

One comment changes from “before the first heartbeat” to “before the bot emits STARTED.” The executable code is unchanged: validateEnvironment() still completes before emitter.emit(BotEvents.STARTED, …).

Why: after heartbeat removal, BotEvents.STARTED is the real startup signal. The revised wording preserves the important operational point: invalid configuration must not make the bot appear alive.

Scope check: a case-insensitive search at the head ref finds no heartbeat references anywhere under validator-cli.

Review verdict + residual findings

Accept

The diff matches F5 Option B exactly. It removes all three validator-side leftovers, introduces no runtime logic, and git diff --check reports no whitespace errors.

  • No scoped leftovers: the deleted helper no longer exists at the head, and neither HEARTBEAT_URL nor the word “heartbeat” remains in validator-cli.
  • Repository-wide heartbeat matches remain in relayer-cli: its README, relayer flow, and its own utility still actively use heartbeats. This is a separate CLI and is not a blocker for the validator-only cleanup.
  • Verification boundary: review used read-only Git inspection; the test suite was not executed. Risk is low because the only source-code behavior change is deletion of an unreferenced module, while the watcher edit is comment-only.

Intent labels: the “why” above is directly supported by the task’s stated Option B cleanup and by reference searches in the compared revisions; no additional product rationale was inferred.
